content.title: French Stocks Drop With Government Facing No-Confidence Vote
content.summary: French markets tumbled Tuesday as political uncertainty mounted ahead of a confidence vote that could bring down Prime Minister François Bayrou’s government. The benchmark CAC 40 dropped as much as 2% on Tuesday, after declining on Monday evening, led lower by banks including Société Générale, BNP Paribas and Crédit Agricole.
